skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Analyze the structure, functions, market segments, current customers, tour programs, and software/systems used in tour design operations.
Analyze the organizational structure, functions, supplier networks, and software/systems used in tour operation management.
Analyze the organizational structure, job descriptions, procedures, requirements, and real-life scenarios in tour guiding operations.
Apply soft skills such as communication, problem-solving, and teamwork to gather information about tour operations and analyze processes.
Adapt to new environments, maintain health and ethical standards, and demonstrate responsibility and commitment during practical training.
Show awareness and respect for environmental protection and cultural values while participating in practical training.
